title: MOC Updates Its Transmission and Brake Fluid Exchange Machines by Replacing Fuses with Resettable Circuit Breakers
lead: MOC has replaced the fuse and fuse holder on all Transmission Fluid Exchange Machines and Brake Fluid Exchange Machines with a resettable circuit. The resettable circuit breakers are more reliable than fuses, and not a disposable item as the fuses were. This means less downtime and cost, and more dependability. The circuit breakers use the same mounting hole on the chassis and connect to the terminals from the wiring harness the same way.
